utterance.description: What the caller just said, verbatim.

from_name.description: Who is calling, as they said it, with how they know her (e.g. 'Richard, from church').

text.description: The message for the family, in the caller's words (short).

callback_number.description: Number to call back if they gave a different one; empty means the number they are calling from.

callback_requested.description: True if they asked to be called back.

lang.description: The language the caller is speaking right now.

request_body_schema.description: Request body for relay_message (receptionist: message for the family)

description: Receptionist mode: the caller leaves a message or asks for a callback. Village posts it to the family chat. Speak the returned say verbatim.
name: relay_message
